For every independent Boolean controller a and fully shared Boolean sources G,H on finite uniform cubes, with c=(1-a)/2, p=Ec, f=(1-c)G+cH, supply normalized source spectral references Rg,Rh positive on their true supports. At every physical history inherit each source reference through its own actual-phase pair-erasure/outcome channel for DATA queries and keep it fixed for CONTROL queries. The erasure path cost is smaller. Relative to actual inherited output references, raw reset kappa_v=sigma_v+E_fv+O_fv, so only net reset after those actual erasure/outcome refunds is charged to Z.
